summary: Verified hero overline readability fix and footer credit link. Hero 'Western & Travel Photographer' overline now renders in light sand color rgb(245,242,235) with text-shadow, no longer clay rgb(178,94,66). Headline 'Where the light still runs wild.' and hero-view-work button present. All nav testids exist (western/travel/prints/journal/about/contact). Footer credit 'Designed by Mo Studio' links to https://mozeid.com/. No console errors on load or during in-page navigation. No 'Made with Emergent' badge in DOM. Regression sections (Western '01 — Selected Work' etc.) still render correctly.
critical_code_review_comments: Hero.jsx correctly bypasses the global .overline rule by using Tailwind text-sand + text-shadow directly instead of the class; fix is targeted and low-risk.
Footer credit link uses target=_blank + rel=noreferrer correctly.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 verified the hero overline color fix (clay→sand) and the newly-added footer-credit link (Designed by Mo Studio → https://mozeid.com/). All hero/nav/footer testids intact, zero console errors, no Emergent badge. Public URL used: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL from /app/frontend/.env.
rca of the issue: Prior bug: global .overline rule in /app/frontend/src/index.css forced clay color on all elements with class 'overline', overriding the hero's intended light color and causing terracotta-on-terracotta contrast failure. Fix (already applied in Hero.jsx): removed the .overline class from the hero overline and used Tailwind text-sand + text-shadow for readability over the horse photo. Verified via getComputedStyle → rgb(245,242,235).
